questions.q: By the time we arrived at the station, the train ______.
questions.e: Hành động xảy ra trước một mốc/hành động khác trong quá khứ (By the time + quá khứ đơn) → dùng quá khứ hoàn thành: had already left.

questions.q: The scientist ______ research on coral reefs won an award last year is giving a talk at our school today.
questions.e: Sau chỗ trống là danh từ "research" (nghiên cứu của nhà khoa học) → cần đại từ quan hệ chỉ sở hữu "whose".

questions.q: A new bridge across the river ______ at the moment, so traffic in the area is very heavy.
questions.e: Chủ ngữ "a new bridge" chịu tác động (bị xây) và có "at the moment" → bị động hiện tại tiếp diễn: is being built.

questions.q: If she ______ the instructions carefully, she wouldn't have made such a serious mistake.
questions.e: Mệnh đề chính "wouldn't have made" → điều kiện loại 3 (trái quá khứ), mệnh đề if dùng quá khứ hoàn thành: had read.

questions.q: If I had accepted that job offer in Da Nang two years ago, I ______ by the sea now.
questions.e: Câu điều kiện hỗn hợp: giả định trái quá khứ (had accepted … two years ago) dẫn đến kết quả trái hiện tại (now) → would + V: would be living.

questions.q: Before making a final decision, you should ______ all the advantages and disadvantages into account.
questions.e: Cụm cố định: take something into account = cân nhắc, tính đến điều gì.

questions.q: The meeting has been ______ until next Monday because the manager is ill.
questions.e: put off = hoãn lại (= postpone). put on: mặc/bật; call up: gọi điện; take over: tiếp quản.

questions.q: Regular exercise has a positive effect on both your physical and mental ______.
questions.e: Sau hai tính từ "physical and mental" cần một danh từ → health (sức khỏe).

questions.q: The city has introduced new measures to make public transport more ______ to elderly and disabled people.
questions.e: Cấu trúc make + O + adj; "more ___ to" cần tính từ → accessible (dễ tiếp cận). be accessible to sb.

questions.q: The heavy rain caused severe flooding, which ______ thousands of families to leave their homes.
questions.e: force sb to do sth = buộc ai làm gì. Các động từ make/let/have dùng với V nguyên mẫu không "to" (made them leave), nên không hợp với "to leave".

questions.q: ______ had the concert started than the power suddenly went out.
questions.e: Cấu trúc đảo ngữ: No sooner + had + S + V3 + than … (vừa mới … thì). Hardly/Scarcely đi với "when", không đi với "than".

questions.t: Danh động từ – động từ nguyên mẫu
questions.q: I clearly remember ______ the door before leaving, but now it is wide open.
questions.e: remember + V-ing = nhớ là đã làm việc gì (hành động đã xảy ra); remember + to V = nhớ phải làm việc gì. Ở đây người nói nhớ đã khóa cửa → locking.

questions.q: Choose the underlined part that needs correction: The number of students (A) who have registered for (B) the English course (C) are increasing (D) rapidly this year.
questions.e: "The number of + N số nhiều" là chủ ngữ số ít → động từ chia số ít: are increasing → is increasing.

questions.q: Choose the underlined part that needs correction: Neither the teacher (A) nor her students (B) was aware (C) that the final exam (D) had been postponed.
questions.e: Với Neither … nor …, động từ chia theo chủ ngữ gần nhất "her students" (số nhiều) → was aware → were aware.

questions.q: Choose the underlined part that needs correction: The (A) economic growth of the region (B) depends heavily (C) on the (D) develop of tourism.
questions.e: Sau mạo từ "the" và trước "of" cần danh từ → develop → development.

questions.q: Choose the underlined part that needs correction: The documentary, (A) that was filmed over three years, (B) shows how (C) climate change is affecting (D) the lives of Arctic animals.
questions.e: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (có dấu phẩy) không dùng "that" → that was filmed → which was filmed.

questions.q: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to: "She started learning English six years ago."
o: She has been learning English for six years.
She has started learning English for six years.
She learned English for six years.
She had learned English six years ago.
questions.e: S + started + V-ing + time + ago = S + have/has been + V-ing + for + time. Hành động bắt đầu từ quá khứ, vẫn tiếp diễn → hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn.

questions.q: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to: "Don't touch the wet paint," the guard said to the children.
o: The guard told the children to not touching the wet paint.
The guard told the children not to touch the wet paint.
The guard asked the children if they touched the wet paint.
The guard reminded the children of touching the wet paint.
questions.e: Câu mệnh lệnh phủ định trong lời nói gián tiếp: tell sb not to do sth.

questions.q: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to: "It was a mistake for you to ignore the doctor's advice."
o: You mustn't have ignored the doctor's advice.
You needn't have ignored the doctor's advice.
You shouldn't have ignored the doctor's advice.
You couldn't have ignored the doctor's advice.
questions.e: shouldn't have + V3 = lẽ ra không nên làm (nhưng đã làm) → diễn tả việc làm sai trong quá khứ. needn't have: không cần làm; couldn't have: không thể nào đã làm.

questions.q: Mai: "Would you mind if I opened the window?" – Nam: "______"
questions.e: Đáp lại lời xin phép "Would you mind if …?" khi đồng ý: "Not at all. Go ahead." (Không phiền gì, cứ làm đi).

questions.q: Linh: "I've just passed my driving test!" – Huy: "______"
o: Never mind. Better luck next time.
questions.e: Bạn báo tin vui (thi đỗ bằng lái) → lời chúc mừng phù hợp.

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: The reasons why traditional farming will soon disappear
The benefits and limitations of growing crops indoors in stacked layers
The history of farming in large cities
How LED lights were invented for agriculture
questions.e: Đoạn 2 nêu ưu điểm, đoạn 3 nêu hạn chế của vertical farming, đoạn 4 kết luận nó bổ sung cho nông nghiệp truyền thống → bài nói về lợi ích và hạn chế của việc trồng cây xếp tầng trong nhà.
questions.ctx:
In many large cities, land is expensive and fresh vegetables often travel hundreds of kilometres before reaching the supermarket. Vertical farming is one response to this problem. Instead of growing crops in wide fields, vertical farms stack them in layers inside buildings, sometimes in old warehouses or even in shipping containers. The plants usually grow without soil, their roots sitting in water that contains carefully measured nutrients, while LED lights replace the sun.
Supporters argue that this method offers several advantages. Because conditions inside the building are controlled, crops can be harvested all year round, regardless of droughts, storms or cold winters. Pests are easier to keep out, so farmers need fewer chemicals. In addition, the water in many systems is recycled, which means far less is wasted than in traditional irrigation. Perhaps most importantly, food can be produced close to the people who eat it, reducing the cost and pollution of long-distance transport.
However, vertical farming is not a perfect solution. The biggest challenge is energy. Lights, pumps and air-conditioning systems must run day and night, and electricity bills can be extremely high. If that electricity comes from burning coal or gas, the environmental benefits may largely disappear. Building a vertical farm also requires a large initial investment, and several companies in the industry have closed after failing to make a profit. Moreover, the technique currently works best for leafy greens and herbs, which grow quickly and are light. Staple crops such as rice or wheat need much more space and light, so growing them indoors is rarely practical.
For these reasons, most experts see vertical farming as a complement to traditional agriculture rather than a replacement for it. As renewable energy becomes cheaper, however, its role may grow.

questions.q: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT mentioned as an advantage of vertical farming?
o: Crops can be harvested throughout the year.
Fewer chemicals are needed to control pests.
It is suitable for growing staple crops such as rice.
Less water is wasted than in traditional irrigation.
questions.e: Đoạn 3 nói cây lương thực như lúa, lúa mì cần nhiều không gian và ánh sáng nên trồng trong nhà "rarely practical" → đây không phải ưu điểm. Ba ý còn lại đều có ở đoạn 2.

questions.q: The word "complement" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to
o: something that adds to and improves another thing
questions.e: "a complement to traditional agriculture rather than a replacement" = thứ bổ sung, hỗ trợ cho nông nghiệp truyền thống chứ không thay thế. (Chú ý phân biệt với compliment = lời khen.)

questions.q: It can be inferred from paragraph 3 that vertical farming is most environmentally beneficial when
o: its electricity comes from renewable sources
it is located in old warehouses
it is used to grow wheat and rice
its plants are grown in soil instead of water
questions.e: Đoạn 3: nếu điện từ đốt than/khí thì lợi ích môi trường gần như biến mất; đoạn 4: năng lượng tái tạo rẻ hơn thì vai trò của nó tăng → có lợi nhất cho môi trường khi dùng điện tái tạo.

questions.q: Which of the following would be the best title for the passage?
o: How to Become a Morning Person
Why Teenagers Struggle to Wake Up Early
The Dangers of Smartphones for Children
Why Adults Need More Sleep Than Teenagers
questions.e: Bài giải thích nguyên nhân sinh học (melatonin tiết muộn) khiến thiếu niên ngủ muộn, khó dậy sớm và hệ quả với lịch học. Phương án về người lớn ngủ nhiều hơn trái với bài; về smartphone chỉ là ý phụ.
questions.ctx:
For decades, parents have complained that teenagers stay up too late and are almost impossible to wake in the morning. It is easy to blame this habit on laziness or on smartphones, but scientists now believe that biology plays an important role.
Every person has an internal "body clock", known as the circadian rhythm, which tells the body when to feel sleepy and when to feel alert. One of the signals this clock uses is melatonin, a hormone that makes us feel tired. During adolescence, the body begins to release melatonin later in the evening than it did in childhood. As a result, many teenagers simply do not feel sleepy until late at night, even if they go to bed early. At the same time, most experts agree that teenagers still need around eight to ten hours of sleep a night, which is more than many adults need.
The problem is that school timetables rarely take this change into account. When classes begin early in the morning, students who fell asleep late are forced to wake up before their bodies are ready. Over time, this lack of sleep can affect their concentration, memory and mood, and it may even make them more likely to have accidents.
Some schools have experimented with starting the day later, and several studies have reported that students in these schools become more alert in class. Critics, however, point out that later start times can create difficulties for parents' work schedules and for after-school activities.
Technology does not help either. The blue light from phone and computer screens can further delay the release of melatonin. Therefore, even if teenagers cannot change their school timetable, they can protect their sleep by putting their devices away at least an hour before bed.

questions.q: According to paragraph 2, what happens to melatonin during adolescence?
o: It is released earlier in the evening.
It is released later in the evening than in childhood.
It makes teenagers feel more alert.
questions.e: Đoạn 2: "the body begins to release melatonin later in the evening than it did in childhood".

questions.e: "this lack of sleep can affect their concentration, memory and mood, and it may even make them more likely to have accidents" → "it" = this lack of sleep (việc thiếu ngủ).

questions.q: The word "alert" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to
questions.e: alert = tỉnh táo, tập trung ≈ attentive. Ngữ cảnh: đi học muộn hơn thì học sinh tỉnh táo hơn trong lớp.

o: Later school start times have no disadvantages.
Going to bed early does not guarantee that a teenager will fall asleep quickly.

questions.q: My brother ______ in Ha Noi since he graduated from university.
questions.e: Có "since + mốc thời gian" → hành động bắt đầu trong quá khứ và kéo dài đến hiện tại → hiện tại hoàn thành: has lived.

questions.q: This is the village ______ my grandparents grew up.
questions.e: Thay cho trạng ngữ nơi chốn (grew up in the village) → where (= in which). Dùng which/that thì phải có giới từ "in".

questions.q: All mobile phones must ______ off before the exam begins.
questions.e: Điện thoại "bị tắt" → bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu: must + be + V3 → must be switched off.

questions.q: If I ______ you, I would apologise to her immediately.
questions.e: Lời khuyên với câu điều kiện loại 2 (giả định trái hiện tại): If I were you, I would …

questions.q: You won't be allowed to enter the exam room ______ you show your student card.
questions.e: Nghĩa: sẽ không được vào trừ khi xuất trình thẻ → unless (= if … not). Dùng if/provided that/as long as thì câu thành "sẽ không được vào nếu xuất trình thẻ" – vô lí.

questions.q: Our school has ______ great progress in reducing plastic waste this year.
questions.e: Cụm cố định: make progress = tiến bộ, đạt tiến triển.

questions.q: It took Minh nearly two weeks to ______ the flu and return to school.
questions.e: get over = khỏi (bệnh), vượt qua. get across: truyền đạt; take after: giống (người thân); give up: từ bỏ.

questions.q: She spoke so ______ about the project that everyone in the room was moved.
questions.e: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ "spoke" cần trạng từ → passionately (một cách say mê).

questions.q: The ______ of the new metro line has greatly reduced traffic jams in the city centre.
questions.e: Sau "the" và trước "of" cần danh từ làm chủ ngữ → completion (sự hoàn thành).

questions.q: His explanation was so ______ that nobody could understand what he really meant.
questions.e: Không ai hiểu → lời giải thích mơ hồ: vague. vivid: sinh động; precise: chính xác; concise: ngắn gọn – đều không dẫn tới "không ai hiểu".

questions.q: Not until she read her father's letter ______ how much he had sacrificed for the family.
questions.e: Cấu trúc Not until + mệnh đề/thời gian + trợ động từ + S + V (đảo ngữ ở mệnh đề chính): did she realise.

questions.q: I wish I ______ more attention in class last week; now I can't do the homework.
questions.e: Ước điều trái với quá khứ (last week) → wish + S + had + V3: had paid.

questions.q: Choose the underlined part that needs correction: My sister (A) is interested (B) in (C) learn foreign languages (D) such as Korean and Japanese.
questions.e: Sau giới từ "in" động từ phải ở dạng V-ing → learn → learning.

questions.q: Choose the underlined part that needs correction: Each of the participants (A) were given a certificate (B) at the end of (C) the two-day (D) workshop.
questions.e: "Each of + N số nhiều" là chủ ngữ số ít → were given → was given.

questions.q: Choose the underlined part that needs correction: Although it rained heavily, the outdoor concert (A) was still (B) attended (C) by (D) a large numbers of fans.
questions.e: Cụm đúng: a large number of + N số nhiều → a large numbers of → a large number of.

questions.q: Choose the underlined part that needs correction: The new law (A) is intended to reduce (B) the amount of cars (C) entering (D) the city centre every day.
questions.e: "cars" là danh từ đếm được số nhiều → dùng "the number of", không dùng "the amount of" (dành cho danh từ không đếm được).

questions.q: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to: "This is the most interesting book I have ever read."
o: I have ever read a more interesting book than this.
I have never read a more interesting book than this.
This book is not as interesting as the books I have read.
This is the first interesting book I have read.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the passage?
o: The training programmes offered by universities
The difficulties of studying distant galaxies
The involvement of ordinary people in scientific research
The effect of climate change on birds
questions.e: Cả bài nói về citizen science – người dân bình thường tham gia vào nghiên cứu khoa học: hình thức, giá trị, lo ngại và lợi ích.
questions.ctx:
In the past, scientific research was carried out almost entirely by professionals working in universities and laboratories. Today, however, ordinary people are increasingly taking part in real scientific projects. This movement is known as citizen science.
Citizen science projects take many forms. Volunteers may count birds in their gardens, photograph insects, measure rainfall, or report the date on which certain flowers first bloom each spring. Others take part from home, using their computers to classify images of distant galaxies or to identify animals caught on hidden cameras. The tasks are usually simple, but when thousands of people contribute, they can produce huge amounts of data that a small research team could never collect on its own.
This information has proved valuable in many fields. Records kept by volunteers over many years, for example, can help scientists understand how the areas where plants and animals live are shifting as the climate changes. In astronomy, members of the public have spotted unusual objects that computer programs had missed.
Of course, there are concerns. Some researchers worry that data gathered by non-experts may contain mistakes. To deal with this problem, projects often provide training, ask several volunteers to check the same item, or compare their results with measurements made by professionals. When these steps are taken, the quality of citizen science data is often surprisingly high.
The benefits are not only scientific. People who take part frequently report that they have learnt a great deal and that they now pay more attention to the natural world around them. In this way, citizen science does more than produce data: it helps to build a society that understands and values science.

questions.q: According to paragraph 2, why do city streets often stay warm after sunset?
o: The wind brings warm air from the countryside.
Building materials release the heat they absorbed during the day.
questions.e: Đoạn 2: bê tông, nhựa đường, gạch hấp thụ nhiệt ban ngày và "release it slowly at night".
questions.ctx:
On a hot summer afternoon, the centre of a large city can feel noticeably warmer than the surrounding countryside. This effect is known as the urban heat island, and it is becoming an important concern as cities continue to grow.
Several factors cause it. Materials such as concrete, asphalt and brick absorb heat from the sun during the day and release it slowly at night, so city streets often stay warm long after sunset. Tall buildings can block the wind, which would otherwise carry heat away. In addition, cars, factories and air-conditioners all produce heat of their own. Meanwhile, cities usually have far fewer trees and green spaces than rural areas. Plants cool the air by providing shade and by releasing water vapour through their leaves, so when they are removed, an important natural cooling system disappears.
The consequences can be serious. Higher temperatures increase the demand for air-conditioning, which raises energy consumption and, in turn, can add to air pollution. During heatwaves, older people and those with health problems are especially at risk, and warm nights make it harder for everyone to sleep well.
Fortunately, city planners have a number of tools to reduce the problem. Planting trees along streets and creating parks are among the most effective. Some cities encourage "green roofs", which are covered with plants, while others paint roofs and pavements in light colours that reflect sunlight instead of absorbing it. Although none of these measures can remove the heat island completely, together they can make cities more comfortable and healthier places to live.

questions.t: Mệnh đề quan hệ rút gọn
questions.q: The students ______ in the science competition will each receive a certificate.
questions.e: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động (who take part) → V-ing: taking part. Câu đã có động từ chính "will receive" nên không dùng took/are taking.

questions.q: The results of the survey ______ next week.
questions.e: Kết quả "được công bố" → bị động; "next week" → tương lai: will be announced.

questions.q: ______ your help, I wouldn't have finished the project on time.
questions.e: But for + N = If it hadn't been for + N (nếu không có…). Unless/If cần mệnh đề; "without of" sai.

questions.q: You should ______ an effort to arrive on time for the job interview.
questions.e: Cụm cố định: make an effort = cố gắng, nỗ lực.

questions.q: Please ______ the application form carefully and return it to the reception desk.
questions.e: fill in a form = điền vào mẫu đơn. put up: dựng/treo; take in: tiếp thu/lừa; hand out: phát.

questions.q: Thanks to modern technology, it is now ______ to talk to friends on the other side of the world at almost no cost.
questions.e: Cấu trúc It is + adj + to V → cần tính từ: possible.

questions.q: The twin sisters look so ______ that even their teachers often confuse them.
questions.e: look alike = trông giống nhau (alike đứng sau động từ, không cần tân ngữ). "like" cần tân ngữ; "same" phải là "the same"; likely = có khả năng.

questions.q: Choose the underlined part that needs correction: Mr Long (A) has worked (B) as a teacher (C) since twenty years (D) and still loves his job.
questions.e: Với khoảng thời gian (twenty years) dùng "for", không dùng "since" → for twenty years.

questions.q: Choose the underlined part that needs correction: (A) It was (B) such a difficult question (C) that nobody (D) were able to answer it.
questions.e: "nobody" là đại từ số ít → were able → was able.

questions.q: Choose the underlined part that needs correction: The manager (A) asked me (B) where did I put (C) the files (D) that she needed.
questions.e: Câu hỏi gián tiếp không đảo trợ động từ và lùi thì: where did I put → where I had put.

questions.q: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to: "Although it was raining heavily, they continued playing football."
o: Because of the heavy rain, they continued playing football.
Despite it was raining heavily, they continued playing football.
Despite the heavy rain, they continued playing football.
In spite the heavy rain, they continued playing football.
questions.e: Although + mệnh đề = Despite/In spite of + cụm danh từ. "Despite it was…" sai cấu trúc; "In spite" thiếu "of"; "Because of" sai nghĩa.

questions.q: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to: "It isn't necessary for you to bring your laptop tomorrow."
o: You mustn't bring your laptop tomorrow.
You should bring your laptop tomorrow.
You can't bring your laptop tomorrow.
You don't have to bring your laptop tomorrow.
questions.e: not necessary = không cần thiết → don't have to. mustn't/can't = cấm, không được phép (khác nghĩa).

questions.q: Waiter: "Are you ready to order?" – Customer: "______"
o: Yes, I'll have the chicken salad, please.
I'd love to, but I can't.
questions.e: Trả lời câu hỏi gọi món của phục vụ: "Yes, I'll have …, please."

questions.q: Which of the following best states the main idea of the passage?
o: Mangrove forests are useless swamps that should be cleared.
Mangrove forests provide many important benefits and deserve protection.
Shrimp farming is the main cause of climate change.
Concrete sea walls are better than natural barriers.
questions.e: Bài lần lượt nêu các lợi ích của rừng ngập mặn (bảo vệ bờ biển, nơi ươm sinh vật biển, lưu trữ carbon) và các nỗ lực bảo vệ, trồng lại.
questions.ctx:
Along many tropical coastlines, including parts of Viet Nam, grow unusual forests whose trees stand with their roots in salt water. These are mangrove forests, and although they were once regarded as useless swamps, scientists now recognise them as some of the most valuable ecosystems on Earth.
One of their most important functions is protecting the coast. The thick, tangled roots of mangrove trees slow down waves and hold the soil in place, reducing erosion. During storms, a wide belt of mangroves can weaken the force of the water before it reaches the villages and farmland behind it. For coastal communities, this natural barrier can be cheaper and longer-lasting than a concrete sea wall.
Mangroves are also nurseries for marine life. Young fish, crabs and shrimps shelter among the roots, where they find food and are hidden from larger predators. Many of these animals later move out to the open sea, so the health of mangrove forests directly affects the catch of local fishermen.
In addition, mangroves play a role in fighting climate change. They store large amounts of carbon, not only in their trunks and leaves but especially in the muddy soil beneath them. When the forests are cut down, much of this carbon can be released into the atmosphere.
Despite these benefits, large areas of mangroves have been cleared over the past decades to make way for shrimp farms, tourism and coastal development. In response, many countries have launched programmes to protect the remaining forests and to replant damaged areas. Such efforts take time, but they show a growing understanding that mangroves are worth far more standing than cut down.

They raise the level of the land.
Their roots slow down waves and hold the soil in place.
